reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The provision of second senior unsecured loan of up to US$ 1.5 million (in MNT equivalent) to be provided under the FIF Youth in Business Programme in Central Asia (YiB CA) in favour of Transcapital NBFI LLC (TCMN or the Company). The proceeds of the Bank's loan will be used for on-lending to eligible micro, small and medium-sized enterprises led by young people under the age of 35 (Youth MSMEs) in line with the eligibility criteria set forth in the YiB CA Policy Statement. In addition, TCMN will track all beneficiaries under the YiB CA by gender and has committed to ensuring that at least 30 per cent of all sub-borrowers will be women.
